episodes.title: All the Flowers in the Garden
episodes.summary: High-profile florist Dalah prepares to style a wedding between two powerful families until the groom mysteriously ends up dead.

episodes.title: Dead Flowers Carry Scents
episodes.summary: The police hone in on their main suspect, but she's nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, a scandalous rumor haunts the Tangsinsup family.

episodes.title: Deconstruct the Arrangement
episodes.summary: Dalah sneaks into the crime scene to start her own investigation with Sarath, who later stumbles upon a disturbing piece of evidence.

episodes.title: Giving Life to the Dead
episodes.summary: Pam admits what she knows to the police, but will they believe her? As Dalah digs deeper into the case, sinister details about Anusorn come to light.

episodes.title: The Focal Point
episodes.summary: New evidence leads the police to a surprising suspect. Later, ominous letters from Dalah compel the Uathepas and the Tangsinsups to meet at her studio.

episodes.title: Natural Selection
episodes.summary: Secrets unravel when Dalah dredges up the past and reveals the truth about Anusorn's death. But an unexpected revelation catches her off guard.
